subject: NexaHealth: private VPC packaging, platform fee and support tier questions
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@nexahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nexahealth.com
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Onboarding questions: private VPC packaging and support options

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is aligned on Redwood as the likely vendor for our private VPC deployment. Before we proceed to internal procurement, we have a handful of commercial and packaging questions we need clarified so we can put together an internal recommendation: 

- How is the platform fee typically amortized? We prefer multi-year amortization but need options for 12/18/24 month schedules.
- Can you outline the support tiers (response SLAs, SRE retainer, monthly hours) and how those map to on-call escalation credits?
- Do you have an operator/site license model vs per-GPU seat? We need clarity for our on-prem aggregator sites.
- What does burst capacity pricing look like if we exceed committed throughput? Is there a usage floor we must commit to?

I've attached our draft statement-of-work and a short procurement questionnaire for your team to fill in. If it's easier, happy to do a 30-minute call early next week.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Patel
Head of Cloud Ops, NexaHealth
samira.patel@nexahealth.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: NexaHealth_SOW_draft_v1.docx (docx)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 13:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding questions: private VPC packaging and support options

Hi Samira — great to hear NexaHealth is moving forward, and thanks for sharing the SOW. Quick answers below and I attached our short PrivDeploy FAQ to this thread. I'm happy to unpack any of these on a call.

- Platform fee amortization: we support 12/18/24 month schedules. Typical customer choice is 24 months for lower monthly expense; we can also do accelerated amortization if you prepay.
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 8x5 response T+8h), Premier (24x7, T+2h), and SRE Retainer (blocks of hours with on-call augmentation). We can map SRE retainers to runbooks & playbooks in the SOW.
- Operator licensing: two options — site-level operator license (flat per-site) or per-GPU operator seats. We'll propose an operator-first SKU for multi-site customers.
- Burst & floors: we ask for a soft usage floor to size reserved capacity; burst pricing is metered at a premium rate and subject to available spare capacity.

Can we do a 30-min sync Monday 9am PT? I'll bring Marissa (commercial) to cover the platform fee mechanics.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood-PrivDeploy-FAQ.pdf (pdf)

From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@nexahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nexahealth.com
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding questions: private VPC packaging and support options

Ben — thanks, Monday 9am PT works. A few follow-ups so Marissa can draft numbers before the call: 

1) For the platform fee, can you give concrete monthly examples for 12/18/24 month amortizations at the scale in our SOW (we included a projected token/embedding volume)?
2) For SRE retainer tiers, can you list what "on-call augmentation" means in hours/month and escalation credit rates for 24x7?
3) For operator licensing, does the site license include operator tooling access for up to X engineers or is that separate seat licensing?
4) We will likely ask finance to anchor to either a consumption-heavy or commit-heavy model. Do you offer blended pricing (commit + headroom with capped burst rate)?

Procurement also requested your standard procurement contact and a sample invoice template so they can validate internal payment flows. Copying our procurement alias.

Thanks and see you Monday,
Samira

Attachment: NexaHealth_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:31:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: NexaHealth asks + suggested commercial posture (sensitive)

Team — quick synthesis from Samira's list ahead of today's call (9am PT). Proposed commercial posture below — please flag if any of this is a non-starter.

Ask summary from customer: platform fee amortization options (12/18/24), SRE retainer details, operator/site license clarity, blended commit vs headroom, procurement/invoice template.

Proposed concessions to win: 
- Offer: 10% discount on the platform fee for a 24-month committed term with 20% prepay.
- Amortization: provide monthly equivalents for 12/18/24; if they prepay 20% we will front-load onboarding credits.
- SRE Retainer: propose two blocks — Silver (40 hrs/mo, business-hours monitoring + T+2h escalation), Gold (120 hrs/mo + 24x7 on-call augmentation). Gold includes 8 global on-call incidents/month before extra incident fees.
- Operator license: make site license inclusive for up to 6 named operators; additional seats at discounted rate year 1.
- Usage floor: propose a soft floor at 50k token-equivalent/month with burst pricing at +45% over committed unit price; allow one free burst month in year 1.
- Migration credit: we can offer a one-time migration credit up to $40k if they sign within 30 days of proposal.

Marissa — can you sketch the exact monthly numbers for the proposal doc and a sample invoice? Rishi/Steph — any risk flags on the SRE Gold wording or operator-inclusive limits?

Ben
(Internal — do not forward outside Redwood)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 11:14:00 -07:00
Subject: NexaHealth commercial proposal and next steps

Hi Samira — great conversation this morning. Attached is a consolidated commercial proposal that reflects the posture we discussed. Key bullets below for procurement: 

- Platform fee amortization: we included 12/18/24 month line items. Example (illustrative): $360k platform fee = $30k/month (12m) | $20k/month (18m) | $15k/month (24m).
- Commitment discount: 10% off platform fee for 24-month term with 20% prepayment.
- SRE Retainers: Silver = 40 hrs/mo (business hours), Gold = 120 hrs/mo + 24x7 on-call augmentation (8 incidents/mo included).
- Operator license: site-authorized operators included (up to 6 named engineers) in the first-year operator bundle; additional seats at 50% off list in year 1.
- Usage floor & burst: proposed soft floor 50k units/mo; burst at +45% unit price; one free burst month in year 1.
- Migration credit: one-time credit up to $40,000 if signed within 30 days.

Attachments: NexaHealth_Redwood_Commercial_Proposal_20260505.pdf (pdf)
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABCD-1234-NXH

Next steps: procurement review -> legal redlines -> signature. Ben, Marissa and Rishi will be available for any follow-up calls.

Best,
Ben

Attachment: NexaHealth_Redwood_Commercial_Proposal_20260505.pdf (pdf)

From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@nexahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Linda Cho <linda.cho@nexahealth.com>, procurement@nexahealth.com
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexaHealth commercial proposal and next steps

Ben — thanks for the clear proposal. Procurement and legal reviewed and have a few counter-requests before we can proceed to signature: 

1) Amortization: request that platform fee is amortized over 18 months by default for our accounting; can you move the 24-month discount into an alternate appendix rather than the base schedule?
2) Migration credit: can the one-time credit be $50k (we will need migration uplift for 4 on-prem sites — engineering cost comps attached).
3) Exit protections: we need a cap on early-exit fees tied to remaining amortized balance (max 6 months of platform fee).

If you can accept the three changes above we can route the redlines to legal immediately. Copying our legal lead Linda on the thread for redlines.

Appreciate the speed here — look forward to locking this down.

Samira

Attachment: NexaHealth_Migration_Costs_Estimate.xlsx (xlsx)
